mechanism: Chlorthalidone may increase dolutegravir levels through UGT1A1 inhibition and can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) that may affect cardiac conduction and QT interval in patients on integrase inhibitors.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly and baseline/periodic ECG; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; dolutegravir dose adjustment typically not required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
